[size=6][i][center][b]~ Chocolate Crops ~[/b][/center][/i]
[/size][size=4][center]Three new crops for growing chocolate![/center]

[center]Hiii~ O actually made this mod because I wanna make another one in which, with chocolate, you can make some recipes I wanted to have, so, here it is!
The chocolate will take about eight days to grow, but once it does it'll give you three bars!
I'm open to suggestions!![/center]
[size=5][i][center][b]DOWNLOAD INSTRUCTIONS[/b][/center]

[/i][/size][size=3]· Download the mod in "Files".[/size]
[size=3]· Once downloaded, extract de zip file, it has a folder inside with the name of the mod.
[size=3]· Place it in your "Mods" folder, located in your Stardew Valley folder.[/size][/size]
[size=3]· Run your game through SMAPI.
[/size][size=3]· Have fun![/size]
